gaps.sentence: It's wise to look ___ before making a career move.
gaps.explanation: look ahead = think about and plan for the future.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.
